body.name: Legal realizable truncated-moment domain
body.construction: \[\Theta_{\ell,R}=\left\{(\gamma,\beta,u,v,m^{S}):\begin{array}{l}\gamma\prod_{i\in I_{\ell}}(u_i-\gamma)(v_i-\beta u_i)\ne0,\ \text{and for every }j\in J_{\ell}\text{ there exist }(w^{S}_{j,k},x^{S}_{j,k})_{k\in K_R}\text{ such that}\\ w^{S}_{j,k}\ge0,\ \sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}=1,\ \sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}x^{S}_{j,k}=0,\ m^{S}_{j,r}=\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}(x^{S}_{j,k})^r\ (0\le r\le R),\ m^{S}_{j,2}>0\end{array}\right\},\qquad a_i=1,\ b_i=u_i-\gamma,\ c_i=v_i-\beta u_i.\]
